Satyrische Dichtung p12.text: In satire, reality as a deficiency is set against the ideal as the highest reality.

transcription.reason: The PDF transcription embeds this complete sentence after an editorial bracketed ellipsis that joins it to a different original place; witness-cut rejects that boundary. I transcribed the complete independent sentence and punctuation directly from printed p. 71, excluding the longer quotation delimiters.
transcription.original_text: In satire, reality as a deficiency is set against the ideal as the highest reality.

The 15 words, final full stop and stated two-line location match the printed translation; the preceding bracketed ellipsis and external closing quote belong to the larger passage. In the attributed research context it does not substitute for the thesis or translated essay.
